The outcome linking anti-HIRI effects to the in vitro experiment is questionable as the synergy statement likely refers to in vivo results. Additionally, an experiment for the in vivo use of the LNP is missing. These issues should be corrected by either splitting the experiment or adding the in vivo context, adjusting evidence quotes, and relinking outcomes appropriately.
